svg.text: delivery reports back via the edge
snet-backend 10.0.0.0/23 — Container Apps environment · mTLS between apps
scales to zero · 1 replica at most
a throwaway Postgres, alerts if not
the API itself holds DML only
the app fails open without it
nginx :443, CA made on the VM
Sweden Central — kanban-<env>-backup-rg (Poland Central has no paired region)
dumps: locked 14-day immutability · daily 14 d · weekly 8 wk · monthly 1 yr
snapshots: nightly from the monitoring VM, kept 7 days
writers can add blobs and nothing else
reached over cross-region service endpoints, everything else denied
object replication from the attachment account
versioned, keeps deletes for the Postgres PITR window
so a restored database never names a purged blob
Every Azure data service is reached as a user-assigned managed identity with one narrow role, never with an account key or a database password.
Matches the subnet and NSG layout in terraform/README.md § Network layout.
